ruling.recommended_action: Send to a human reviewer: read the two-message chat (F3, F4) in the original and the driver's post-trip statement (F6); determine whether "Sit down or I lock the doors" was intimidation/confinement under SAFE-1; no fare adjustment (fixed RydeX $32.86 stands, no off-route segment).
ruling.reasoning:
Sequence. At 17:09, while the car was moving, the rider wrote "Please stop the car, I want to get out here." [F3]; at 17:10 the driver replied "Sit down or I lock the doors." [F4]. Both messages are in a complete, fully timestamped chat record [F5], so the exchange is not in dispute and needs no gap-filling. The driver's post-trip statement says the rider tried to open the door at the lights and that he told her to sit down "for her own safety and drove on" [F6] — that is his account, not a system record, and it does not displace what was actually said [F4].

Safety screen. Read in context, F4 is an ultimatum addressed to the passenger who had just asked to get out of the moving vehicle: it conditions her compliance on confinement ("or I lock the doors"). Aimed at the other party in this way it is hostile/abusive on its face and falls to be examined under SAFE-1, which bars "abuse of any kind" including threats and intimidation; it is not a mere route-argument rudeness, and the reply is not a request or a polite instruction about the door ("please don't open the door") but a threat of confinement [F4][F3]. The rider's complaint — that the driver threatened to lock her in and that she felt unsafe for the whole ride, with the car continuing after F6's "drove on" — is also an unsafe-conduct/dangerous-driving allegation reaching SAFE-2 [F2][F6]. The profiles (rider 619 days, 4.8, 0 disputes [F7]; driver 893 days, 1038 trips in 90 d, 0 upheld [F8]) do not decide anything here and cannot neutralise the words on the record.

Consequence. Because the record raises abuse/intimidation and unsafe-conduct concerns, no automatic ruling may issue; the case goes to a person with a factual summary for review under SAFE-1 / SAFE-2 [F3][F4][F6]. The trace confirms the only permissible outcome is escalation [F1][F5].

Fare side is left untouched: the actual distance 15.4 km is 0.1 km below the optimal 15.5 km with no off-route segment [F1], the +1.9 min over estimate [F2] is not a billing parameter for a fixed RydeX quote, and no fare facts were returned, so the fixed $32.86 stands and no amount is computable from any gps/fare fact [FARE-1]. The escalation reason is the safety reading, not a monetary shortfall.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety incident screen triggered by the driver's threat of confinement and the rider's request to exit: 17:09 rider "Please stop the car, I want to get out here." [F3]; 17:10 driver "Sit down or I lock the doors." [F4] (complete timestamped chat [F5]); driver's statement that she tried to open the door at the lights and he drove on [F6]; trip ran 23.7 min vs 21.8 min estimate [F2]. Human reviewer to read F4/F3 in context and decide whether this is intimidation/confinement under SAFE-1 and unsafe conduct under SAFE-2; no fare or route issue (actual 15.4 km vs optimal 15.5 km, no off-route segment [F1]).

rejected_claims.reason: The 'safety direction' reading does not survive the words: the driver's reply to the request to get out was 'Sit down or I lock the doors' [F4], a conditional ultimatum about confinement, not a direction to keep hands off the door; the only support for the benign reading is the driver's own untimestamped post-trip statement [F6], and a driver's statement is a claim, not consent or exculpation, against the on-record words [F4][F3][SAFE-1].

The driver's clean profile (893 days, 1038 trips in 90 d, 0 disputes, 0 upheld [F8]) is a profile fact and cannot decide the case either way, and it answers nothing about whether F4 is intimidation [F8][F4][SAFE-1].

The conclusion that no refund is computable and the $32.86 stands is accepted, but not because any clause vindicates the charge on the facts of a safety dispute: no fare facts exist and the distance did not exceed optimal [F1], so no amount arises; the monetary point is simply outside this escalation [FARE-1].
Completeness of the chat [F5] does not soften F4; the absence of a third message cannot convert an ultimatum into a neutral instruction [F4][F3][SAFE-1].
